notes.title: Soldiers! New procedures must be tested!
notes.notes:
[b]Soldiers! [/b]

[b]New procedures must be tested![/b]

In the base, in production, improvements have been introduced.
[b]
 Objective  [/b]
[b][b]First step:[/b] download the update, start production, and observe how it works.
Second step:[/b] If the production stops working, shut the game down and send the logs. 

[b]Logs location:[/b] \AppData\Local\ProjectWunderwaffe\Saved\Logs
[b]Send logs to: [/b]pw@gameparic.com

notes.title: Added information: production buildings and warehouses
notes.notes:
✅ Added information: production buildings and warehouses

✅ Weapon Production Line and Cement Plant textures have been improved

✅ Probability of sabotage is reduced

✅ "Classified" signs on loading windows are changed

notes.title: Added descriptions to the Technology Tree
notes.notes:
✅ Added descriptions to the Technology Tree

✅ Scroll action in Technology Tree is fixed

✅ Speed of map panning when "Shift" is pressed (WSAD + Shift) is increased

✅ Operation of control buttons in the start information windows is improved

notes.title: Incorrect display of 'resource consumption 'information has been fixed.
notes.notes:
✅ Incorrect display of 'resource consumption 'information has been fixed.

✅ Added information: How does the Mine work?

✅ Cost of building a Mine - reduced.

notes.title: The canteen now produces food rations.
notes.notes:
✅ The canteen now produces food rations.

✅ The rate and quantity of gold melting have increased.

notes.title: Improved tech tree balance
notes.notes:
✅ Fix of a flatbed wagon texture, historically correct

✅ Improved tech tree balance

✅ More gold in supplies

notes.notes: Building objects on edges of the map is fixed.
